articles.title: Russia Prepares to Test New Nuclear-Capable Missile Amid US-Russia Summit
articles.summary: According to a report by Reuters, Russia is preparing to test its new nuclear-capable intercontinental ballistic missile, the 9M730 Burevestnik, which has been described as having a 'limitless' range and the ability to evade US missile defense systems. The test is believed to be scheduled for August 9-22, and could potentially coincide with the upcoming US-Russia summit on August 15. Experts have noted that Russia has been working on the development of this missile since the US announced its plans to develop a new missile defense system, known as the 'Golden Dome', in January. The Burevestnik missile has been described as a 'game-changer' by Russian President Vladimir Putin, who has boasted that it is 'invulnerable' to US missile defense systems. However, experts believe that Putin may be using the test as a way to show his commitment to ending the war in Ukraine and restarting arms control talks with the US. 'It's possible that Putin is using this as a way to show his commitment to ending the war in Ukraine and restarting arms control talks with the US,' said Jeffrey Lewis, director of the East Asia Nonproliferation Program at the Middlebury Institute of International Studies. 'The test is likely to be scheduled for before the summit, and it's possible that Putin is using this as a way to create a sense of urgency and momentum for the talks.'
